text:
frank: Planning a compact base-image rebuild + signing next Fri (2026-02-06). Need sign-off on RBAC window, audit sinks, and rollback guardrails.
nina: Outline please — duration, who toggles KMS binding, smoke tests?
frank: 2hr signer window. raj will add `roles/cloudkms.signer` to the builder SA for the window then revoke. Build -> cosign sign+attest -> deploy canary.
raj: Command I'll run: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ik/cryptoKeys/signer --member=\"serviceAccount:svc-image-build@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" --role=\"roles/cloudkms.signer\"` and remove afterwards.
frank: Audit checklist: IAM policy change logs to `projects/redwood-logs/sinks/kms-iam`; key use logs to SIEM rule `kms-usage`; artifact signature metadata to Artifact Registry.
nina: Vulnerability gating: pre-scrub and post-scrub `trivy fs --severity CRITICAL,HIGH` + `syft -o json sbom.json`. Fail and rollback on any new CRITICAL.
raj: Will add revoke script in `infra/signer-window/` and a PR template that records approver signatures.
ops-bot: Pre-window reminder scheduled: `2026-02-06T08:40:00Z` -> #eng-security.
sec-bot: Alert created `kms-binding-change` -> opens incident in #eng-oncall when triggered.
nina: Runtime canary: 3m warmup, hit /health and a tiny inference endpoint; if error rate > 7% rollback. Add runbook snippet.
frank: Note: follow-up work to evaluate ephemeral KMS keys (short-lived keys per-build) as lower-risk option. For this rollout we accept timeboxed RBAC with strict logging.
raj: ack, will push scripts and timeline PR.
nina: ack, will create alerts and confluence doc.
sec-bot: Reminder posted 20m before window.
